description: This script defines test procedures for verifying the preservation of commit subjects in patch operations using git commands such as format-patch and am. It sets up test scenarios with different subject lengths and formats, and checks that the commit messages are correctly preserved after patch application.

methods.name: make_patches
methods.description: Creates git patches with specified subject type and message, and checks out the patches.

methods.name: check_subject
methods.description: Resets to baseline, applies a patch, and compares the log message to the expected value.
